numerical_precision.metrics_source: governed CSV/JSON/native arrays; never display pixels

governance.historical_freeze_v1_note: Retained unchanged as pre-Phase-2E provenance. Its recorded hashes describe the governance documents as they stood at v1 and no longer match the current working copies of those documents.
governance.phase2b_source_scale_axial_role: historical earlier accepted visual diagnostics; superseded for final quantitative source-scale axial detail
governance.route_calibration_flag_meaning: calibration_required=false on nominal_no_additional_aperture means only that no additional aperture calibration is required to define that numerical route. It does not mean experimentally calibrated, absolute physical scale verified, bench validated, or fluence calibrated.

scale_separation.source_scale: tens of mm axial propagation; tens of um transverse Bessel/ring scale
scale_separation.objective_sample_scale: Phase 2C Debye focal plane; approximately micron transverse scale
